messages.body_plain:
Sir,

Hope this email finds you well.

I'm doing scar hrd analysis for my project. It requires .seqz.gz file as input. But, I only have vcf file (which contain information about both tumor and panel of normal) When i execute the below code, I encountered an error.
sequenza-utils snp2seqz --vcf sample_calls.vcf.gz -gc genome_gc50.wig.gz \
--output samples.seqz.gz Here is the error message that I got.

I kindly request you to guide me in this regard.
Regards,
SAHAL P
